title: Affine sections of a finitely presented sheaf are finitely presented
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], F an O_X-module of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], and U an affine open. The module Gamma(U,F) is finitely presented over Gamma(U,O_X).

proof.text: Cover U by basic opens lying in a finite-local-presentation cover. On each basic open, restrict its presentation to Spec of its section ring, where the finite generators and relations give finitely presented global sections. These basic opens span the unit ideal. The source theorem descends finite presentation along their section localizations using Module.FinitePresentation.of_localizationSpan'.
